use: Strict evidence-scoped NPC speech. A witnessed event is not an adjacent event at the same location. Distinguish negative witness from uncertain knowledge.

shiki.rain_genin.forest_encounter.limits: Ren personally witnessed the final Rain genin declare surrender while restrained; Aki did not personally witness the final kill. Do not give Aki the surrendered detail without report.

gaara.forest_death_actions.indirect_knowledge_possible: Arrival at the tower; hearsay; later testimony, if it actually occurs
gaara.forest_death_actions.limits: No member of Shiki's team watched Gaara fight or kill in the forest. Mere knowledge of 97-minute arrival or violent reputation does not make anyone an eyewitness.

gaara.hinata.prelim.limits: Ren personally watched Gaara injure Hinata and the official stoppage. He may draw inferences about Gaara's ability or brutality only from the arena bout.

gaara.shiki.cafeteria.limits: The question 'When you kill someone, do you feel you exist?' was Gaara speaking to Shiki; it is NOT a confession that Gaara himself only feels alive when killing. Infer with uncertainty.

mio.beam.rescue.limits: Neither Ren nor Aki saw the beam rescue; later reliable report must be explicit.

shiki.yoroi.medical_dialogue.limits: Kabuto saw Shiki go to the wing, not the content of his conversation with the surgeon; his guess remains conjecture.

shiki.kabuto.training_agreement.known_team_information: Aki knows that Shiki sought a private meeting with Kabuto; neither Aki nor Ren heard what they agreed on. Kabuto offered initial trial training at 06:30 Monday 8 July, but Shiki has not told either teammate as of 22:51 July 7.
shiki.kabuto.training_agreement.invalidated_line: Aki: «Завтра у Шики тренировка с Кабуто» said at ~22:49 July 7 in «Белая цапля» is NPC knowledge leakage and noncanonical. Ren's rejoinder about tomorrow's training is likewise noncanonical.
shiki.kabuto.training_agreement.retcon_scope: Do not invent Aki alternative dialogue. No game time advancement for OOC correction. Aki may ask or guess but not know time or training without an actual report.

shiki.kabuto.research_interests_july14.actual_dialogue: Генетическая ассимиляция, изменение биохимии, димеиленизация, блокада рецепторов, увеличение афиности рецепторов, изменение тока чакры, блок узлов распределения. Поэтому нейрофизиология и психофизиология тоже, но с ними я в большей степени дружу. Это то что вспомнилось сразу.
shiki.kabuto.research_interests_july14.kabuto_can_know: Shiki enumerated research interests, potentially including demyelination (term imprecise), receptor affinity and blockade, chakra node flow and distribution, biochemistry and assimilation. He did not answer whether research target is himself or others, does not disclose Zero Genome nor state an actual experimental procedure or chosen victim. Kabuto may infer, ask, misinterpret, or be skeptical, but cannot know unreported secret.
shiki.kabuto.research_interests_july14.limits: Do not make Aki/Ren hear scene. Do not claim Kabuto knows Zero Genome, genetic mutation or Shiki's intention of permanent modification. Distinguish research interest from achieved skill.

shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.other_presence: Librarian and some visitors elsewhere in the room, no evidence they directly observed the incision or regeneration. Do not imply universal knowledge.
shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.player_actions: Shiki gives ordered study levels (molecular, cellular, isolated systems, organism); explains current study is elective due to limitations in his village; for first time genuinely thanks Kabuto; takes ordinary scalpel and cuts own finger deeply, actively uses Zero Genome to heal, asks Kabuto to keep it private for now. No player authorization to disclose detailed inner workings or gift samples.
shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.kabuto_observations: He sees an intentional finger incision and anomalously swift self-healing, with chakra activity; he can infer unusually advanced healing/self-regulation but does not know the hidden name Zero Genome, its heredity or whole mechanism. He perceives Shiki's genuine gratitude as an unusual shift in visible expression.
shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.kabuto_obligations: Request for discretion is not an oath/automated guarantee. Kabuto has espionage agenda and autonomous interests; no automatic disclosure until it is played as an event with cause and time.
shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.knowledge_boundaries: Aki and Ren not present, unaware of demonstration. No accidental bystander witnessing without narrated perception. No automatic source of blood sample for Kabuto.

shiki.kabuto.zero_genome_disclosure_july.source: Direct user-played speech to Kabuto 21 July, following observed 14 July finger healing.
shiki.kabuto.zero_genome_disclosure_july.verbatim: Нет Кабуто, я не дам кровь. Но как и обещал, расскажу. Это кекей генкай, мало кто вообще знает, закрытый архив травы и я. Даже родители не в курсе. Нулевой геном, я не просто управляю своей физиологией, я управляю своими генами. То заживление было по принципу изменения физиологии на генетическом уровне. Базовых знаний генетики достаточно для такого, а так же для работы с хорошо известными ядами и токсическими агентами. Предположительно возможно ассимиляция с другим геномом. Поэтому мне и нужно хорошо знать генетику.
facts: Shiki refuses Kabuto's requested blood sample; there is NO transfer or theft of sample in this interaction.
Shiki calls his kekkei genkai Zero Genome and claims direct control of his own genes and resultant physiology; he interprets July14 regeneration as gene-level biological control.
Shiki states only himself and a closed Kusagakure archive know secret; parents don't know full nature. This does not erase their prior knowledge of Shiki's childhood unusual minor regeneration.
Shiki claims familiar toxin biochemistry is within his current biological understanding; assimilation of another genome is hypothetical, not proven or learned.
shiki.kabuto.zero_genome_disclosure_july.kabuto_knowledge: Kabuto hears direct testimony and previously observed wound repair. He now knows the NAME, CLAIMED mechanism, secrecy, possible applications and blood sample refusal, NOT experimental proof of genome editing, actual full power, or confidential archive contents. He is not obliged to swear eternal secrecy, may investigate autonomously using only causal opportunities; must not magically obtain sample.
shiki.kabuto.zero_genome_disclosure_july.limits: Aki/Ren/parents have no new knowledge from this conversation. Kabuto has covert Orochimaru allegiance, but do not invent immediate off-screen delivery or witness to leave player no agency; track later NPC agenda causally, never disclose private Kabuto thoughts as perceived by Shiki.

shiki.kabuto.spy_accusation_pigment_july.source: Прямой игровой ввод пользователя 12 ноября 2026; продолжение разговора Шики с Кабуто после раскрытия названия Нулевой Геном.
player_speech: Вот я и сообщил шпиону тайну деревни [Шики искренне смеётся].
Отвечая на вопрос, мне не хватает знаний, исследований и пока что чакры.
shiki.kabuto.spy_accusation_pigment_july.player_action: Шики сознательно на небольшом участке кожи руки ускоренно меняет пигментацию до тёмной, затем возвращает к обычной; это простой, доступный и безболезненный для него контроль собственного организма посредством Нулевого Генома. Никакого образца не передано.
shiki.kabuto.spy_accusation_pigment_july.kabuto_access: Кабуто лично видит намеренное обратимое изменение пигментации без обычной медицинской обработки; слышит прямое слово «шпион» адресованное ему. Он может воспринять его как обвинение, шутку или проверку; НЕ знает, откуда у Шики сведения и знает ли тот действительно его принадлежность, и НЕ обязан признаваться. Слышит ограничения: знания, исследования и чакра.
shiki.kabuto.spy_accusation_pigment_july.secret_status: Кабуто фактически шпион Орочимару по GM-карточке, но не разоблачён доказательствами перед игроком; эта реплика НЕ превращает догадку Шики в установленное им знание, не гарантирует добровольного признания NPC.
shiki.kabuto.spy_accusation_pigment_july.audience: Только Шики и Кабуто присутствуют, дверь закрыта; Аки и Рэн не знают. Кабуто знает заявленное название Нулевого Генома из разговора ранее.
shiki.kabuto.spy_accusation_pigment_july.mechanical_rule: Смена локальной пигментации не требует высокой сложности/броска. Прямое заявление игрока о лёгкости процесса имеет приоритет. Описать изменение управления пигментными клетками и распределением меланина с кеккей-генкай сверхобычной скоростью, без ложной необходимости длительного образования.

shiki.kabuto.spy_inference_explained_jul.source: Player's direct reply to Kabuto's question, 2026-11-12.
shiki.kabuto.spy_inference_explained_jul.verbatim: Поведение, скрытность, опыт, ведение бесед, подготовка, несоответствие мимики причем все это так отточено что и заметить трудно, нужно быть параноиком. #улыбачсь# а я параноик. Да все это косвенные вполне себе нормальные вещи. Но если все сложить во едино начиная от начала экзамена до сейчас, переглядки со звуком, с песком. А ещё эти карточки. В общем у меня 90% уверенности что вы господин Кабуто шпион, причем либо звука, либо песка, ставлю на звук. Но 90% статистически недостоверный результат. И прежде чем вы отреагируете, мне совершенно плевать правда это или нет я преследую свои личные цели. И в этом смысле разглашение тайны деревни достаточная цена для получаемой информации. При этом я не кому не обещал молчать. Видите, как удобно, а вот передавать доказательства мне нельзя, поэтому никакой крови. В общем как-то так

meaning.reported_inference: Shiki says he suspects Kabuto is spy for Sound, alternatively Sand, by accumulating weak cues: behavior, stealth, trained nonverbal incongruity, interviews, Kabuto's information cards and claimed glances with Sound/Sand. He estimates subjective 90% and explicitly acknowledges the evidence is inconclusive; do not turn claim of glances into established externally witnessed fact without other event provenance.
meaning.strategic_posture: Shiki explicitly says he pursues personal goals, chooses to reveal Zero Genome in exchange for information, gives no promise not to reveal Kabuto's secrets, withholds blood to avoid material proof.
meaning.knowledge: Kabuto hears all statements directly, now knows Shiki is deliberately evaluating/possibly pressuring his role and has no secrecy pledge. He has not confessed, nor confirmed any accusation.

shiki.kabuto.spy_inference_explained_jul.restrictions: NPC Kabuto is a covert operative for Orochimaru who maintains ordinary Konoha genin persona; must respond independently without blatant confession, and not presuppose Shiki's true beliefs or exact evidence; no Aki/Ren telepathy. No obligatory violence. Keep Shiki's explicit smile only; don't add inner motivations.

require_check: Who personally observed exactly this event?
Is this event different from an adjacent one in the same forest, exam, or medical wing?
What is the referent of this/it/him/there/in the forest?
Does a reference to the previous conversation subject falsely imply witnessing a different event?
If indirect, identify who reported, when and with which wording; no report by inference alone.
If no source, phrase as speculation without fake eyewitness authority, or omit.
